'''Xorrn''' was a mineral rich [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Ferra sector/Legends|Ferra sector]] within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Xorrn was a young planet. As the surface of the planet had only recently begun to cool, the natural resources of the planet were easily accessed. However the unstable crust and prohibitive start-up costs prevented nearly all mining operations.<ref name="Friends Like These" />

==History==
[[File:FriendsLikeThese_FC_BG_art.png|thumb|left|250px|The Graveyard of Xorrn]]
Before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]] used Xorrn to illegally build [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]. The Geonosians tried to erect their traditional [[Geonosian hive/Legends|hive spires]] on the planet, though all collapsed before their completion because of Xorrn's thin crust. To overcome the problem the Geonosians started to reverse build their spires, excavating them instead of erecting. This allowed Xorrn to become the Geonosians' best-kept secret. Millions of battle droids were produced by the hives on Xorrn without the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] even noticing. Making the Geonosians the only ones thus far to find any success on the planet. The secrecy of the Geonosian operations on Xorrn didn't last long.

A short while after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|outbreak]] of the Clone Wars, Xorrn was discovered by the Republic. The planet became a target of numerous Republic [[Battle of Xorrn (Clone Wars)/Legends|attacks]]. When several assaults at Xorrn and other Geonosian worlds failed, the Republic decided not to waste anymore losses on capturing the planet. The sector fleet [[Bombardment of Xorrn/Legends|bombarded]] the Geonosian hives, destroying dozens of [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Core ship/Legends|Core ships]] in the process. They still lay scattered around the planet's surface at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], when Xorrn was the location of [[Battle of Xorrn|another battle]].<ref name="Friends Like These" />
